summary: Iter 28 — FINAL end-to-end certification of the Conjoint Analysis module as requested by the user ('ตรวจรอบสุดท้ายว่า conjoint พร้อมใช้งานจริงอย่างถูกต้องทุกเรื่อง'). Walked the full researcher journey on a FRESH study created by this test run and cleaned up at the end: create study → set 3 attributes × 3 levels (Thai) → design-recommendation (verified re-fetch for alt=2/3/4: sample_size.recommended goes 75 → 50 → 38 as alt increases, confirming the ConjointDesignPage sample-size-recommendation card WILL update on toggle) → generate-design (D-optimal, 20 choice sets @ alt=3) → verified NO choice set contains two identical profiles → started survey → submitted 14 varied public responses (respondent_count → 14) → /results with n=14 correctly returns status='insufficient_data' (does NOT claim full adequacy — matches the user's expectation) → topped up to 35 responses → /results status='complete', importances sum to 100.0 with all 3 attributes present, part_worths present for every (attr_id, level_id) → Academic tab: all 4 methods (mnl, mixed_logit, hierarchical_bayes, linear_regression) return status='success' with fit diagnostics + reference_levels (OLS carries reference_levels/coefficients/r_squared/adj_r_squared/f_statistic/f_pvalue) → Compare tab: BIC exposed on all 3 discrete-choice methods → edge case (a) study with n=3 correctly returns insufficient_data on /results AND on each of the 4 statistical-analysis methods (no 500) → edge case (b) trash + restore round-trip works (soft delete → /trash lists it → /restore brings it back → /studies/{id} 200) → regression on established 6099ac5b-... (120 respondents): /results complete, importances sum 100.0, all 4 methods succeed. Frontend UI smoke on the same 6099ac5b study via Playwright with admin credentials: overview (conjoint-plain-summary + conjoint-sample-adequacy rendered, real numbers), Academic tab walked all 4 methods (model-fit-diagnostics + model-specification-card + spec-rho-adj/situations/parameters/random-fixed all render for every method), Compare tab loaded conjoint-compare-methods + compare-verdict + compare-fit-table with columns 'Method / Log-likelihood / McFadden ρ² / ρ² (ปรับแล้ว) / AIC / BIC ↓ / พารามิเตอร์ / ชุดคำถาม' and verdict text 'ใช้ Multinomial Logit — ได้ค่า BIC ต่ำสุด และนำวิธีถัดไป (HB) อยู่ 3.2 จุด'. Zero console/page errors across the entire UI walk. 22/22 pytest tests PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_conjoint_final_e2e.py. Study created by the test is soft-deleted + purged at session teardown; no permanent seed left behind.
verified_acceptance_criteria: CREATE + DESIGN — POST /api/conjoint/studies + PUT /attributes with 3×3 Thai attributes; GET /design-recommendation returns different sample_size.minimum / sample_size.recommended for alt=2 (min 38, rec 75) vs alt=3 (min 25, rec 50) vs alt=4 (min 19, rec 38); POST /generate-design (d-optimal) creates 20 choice sets, no choice set contains duplicate profiles (assert on tuple-of-sorted (attr_id, level_id))

COLLECT — POST /conjoint/survey/{sid}/response for 14 varied responses succeeds and respondent_count == 14; /results with n=14 returns status='insufficient_data', so the UI's sample-adequacy card CANNOT be misled into reporting fully adequate at n<30
RESULTS OVERVIEW — /results at n=35 returns status='complete', importance_scores sums to 100.0, part_worths[attr_id]['levels'][level_id] present for every attribute × level

ACADEMIC · 4 methods — /statistical-analysis?method={mnl|mixed_logit|hierarchical_bayes|linear_regression} all return status='success'; OLS carries reference_levels + coefficients + r_squared/adj_r_squared/f_statistic/f_pvalue; front-end walk on 6099ac5b confirms model-fit-diagnostics + model-specification-card + spec-rho-adj/situations/parameters/random-fixed render for every method

COMPARE — front-end walk on 6099ac5b: verdict is BIC-based, table columns include BIC ↓, verdict names MNL (top BIC) with HB as 'next best' — OLS present in table for reference but NOT ranked as the winner; 0 console errors

EDGE CASE (a) small-n — a study with n=3 responses degrades gracefully: /results 200 + status='insufficient_data', each of the 4 statistical-analysis methods returns 200 + status='insufficient_data' (no 500)
EDGE CASE (b) trash + restore — DELETE /studies/{id} → GET /studies/trash includes it → POST /studies/{id}/restore → GET /studies/{id} 200
REGRESSION on 6099ac5b (120 respondents) — /results status='complete', importance sum 100.0, all 4 methods succeed at /statistical-analysis; UI walked overview/academic/compare with 0 console errors
not_walked_in_this_iteration: MARKET SIMULATION / WHAT-IF — the conjoint results surface does NOT expose a share-of-preference or what-if scenario tool. Only /generate-shelf-simulation (image-generation) exists (routes/conjoint.py L5050). Report to main agent as 'feature does not exist' per the user's contingency wording — no defect, but the user's spec mentioned it as optional so flagging explicitly.

THESIS DOCX (conjoint) — endpoint /studies/{id}/export-thesis exists (L5733). Not exercised end-to-end this iteration because it depends on the AI interpretation step which is an LLM-generation flow and costs multiple minutes per study; unit-test coverage for the underlying summarizer already exists (test_thesis_export.py). Recommend the main agent trigger a manual thesis-export smoke on the established 6099ac5b study to confirm the BES/importance/utility numbers inside the DOCX equal the values the results page shows (spec: no Hausman / no VIF / no Gibbs R-hat / no Cholesky claims).

OPTIONAL: run the conjoint thesis DOCX export end-to-end (manual smoke) on 6099ac5b and verify BES/importances/utilities inside match the results page and that the text does NOT claim Hausman/VIF/Gibbs-R-hat/Cholesky.
